seoDescription: Current and former Fox Valley Physical Therapy patients can reserve the only therapeutic pool in Oshkosh for independent exercise. $35 a month for 2 visits a week.
heroText: Keep up your progress in the only therapeutic pool in Oshkosh. Current and former patients can reserve the pool for their own exercise.
title: Your Own Hour In The Pool
text: The pool is reserved for one person at a time, so the hour is yours. Most people book a month at a time.
points: Open to current and former Fox Valley PT patients
Book any hour the clinic is open. Last start time is {lastStart}, out of the pool by {outBy}.
A signed pool waiver is required before your first swim

tips.title: Be On Time
tips.text: Come at the time you signed up for. Someone may be booked right after you.

tips.title: Sign The Waiver
tips.text: Everyone signs a pool waiver before their first session. Ask the front desk.

faq.question: Who can use the pool?
faq.answer: Current and former Fox Valley Physical Therapy patients. The pool isn't open to the general public.

faq.question: How much does it cost?
faq.answer: {poolPrice} a month for {visitsPerWeek} visits a week. Most people book and pay a month at a time.

faq.question: When can I book?
faq.answer: Any hour the clinic is open. Sessions are 60 minutes, the last start time is {lastStart}, and everyone is out of the pool by {outBy}.

faq.question: Will anyone else be in the pool?
faq.answer: No. The pool is reserved for one person at a time, so the hour is yours.

faq.question: I'm not a patient yet. Can I use the pool?
faq.answer: Pool access is for current and former patients. If you're interested in aquatic therapy with one of our therapists, call us to schedule an evaluation.

ctaText: Call the front desk to reserve your hours for the month.
